name: instagram_media_status
description: Whether a container from instagram_create_media is ready to publish: { status_code, status, id }. `status_code` is EXPIRED, ERROR, FINISHED, IN_PROGRESS or PUBLISHED, and only FINISHED may be passed to instagram_publish_media. Images are usually ready at once; video and reel containers are not, so poll this instead of retrying the publish blindly. A container expires 24 hours after it is created; ERROR or EXPIRED means make a new one, not try again.

container_id.description: The `id` instagram_create_media returned. A container, not a published post.
